source_to_method.entry_api: benchmark_reported_answers(archive: Path, native: Path, *, root: Path) -> PrivateBenchmarkResult
source_to_method.loaded_identity: exact expected local root paths and byte hashes for all five loaded modules; verify witness imported classifier and kernel callables belong to the verified implementations before guard entry
source_to_method.forbidden_flow: do not call inspect_selected_fields, export decoder records, or add a source-loader bypass
source_to_method.response_conversion: only selected native response tokens: strip ordinary ASCII spaces; blank/single-period reader missing -> existing classifier empty missing token; no numeric/bool coercion or Unicode normalization
source_to_method.response_consistency: rerun unchanged classifier and require equality with decoder category; retain blank versus period role privately
source_to_method.frame_retention: every decoded row exactly once; no row filter, collapse or imputation
source_to_method.roles: record type10/year2025 enforced by unchanged decoder; sample_adult status must be known, never resolved by diabetes answer
source_to_method.private_key_policy: missing or duplicate interpreted HHX or lexical aliases => whole method unavailable; do not infer unique people or collapse
source_to_method.demographic_policy: unknown and topcoded age, sex and proxy roles retained; no hidden domain or eligibility rule
source_to_method.production_reference_count: require fixed delivery reference_records; synthetic patched delivery fixtures use explicitly separate expected fixture size, not a production bypass

method_policy.weight: all native Decimal weights finite positive; round explicitly nearest binary64 via float(Decimal), not exact representability
method_policy.design: all native stratum/PSU integers known positive and representable without float identity coercion; nested pair grouping
method_policy.refusal_role: conservative supported-method policy, not producer exclusions or source/clinical identification conclusion
method_policy.variance: complete seven-by-seven covariance including negative off-diagonals and expected partition singularity; all design rows kept

numeric_checks.constant_role: declared binary64 software checks, not empirical parameters or clinical acceptance
numeric_checks.bounds: each finite ratio in [0,1]; every covariance entry finite; diagonal variance nonnegative
numeric_checks.covariance_closure_and_symmetry: absolute pair symmetry differences and compensated row/column sums <=64*epsilon*covariance_scale
numeric_checks.underflow_edge: if scale>0 and computed tolerance==0, whole result unavailable; no max(1,scale) absolute floor or repair
numeric_checks.other_failure: nonfinite compensated result or arithmetic exception => whole joint unavailable

private_schema.repr: constant <PrivateNHISReportedAnswerBenchmark>; no record or value repr
private_schema.immutable: frozen private serialized snapshots; accessors return fresh dictionaries; no native bytes, records, keys, raw tokens, paths or exception objects retained

record_ledger.role_counts: existing fixed decoder age/sex/proxy/sample-adult role vocabularies
record_ledger.response_reader_missingness: DIBEV_A and DIBTYPE_A only; each fixed blank/single_period/not_missing counts conserving total_records
record_ledger.postdecode_method_refusal: retain complete approved ledger, no partial ratio/covariance

joint.success: seven fixed coordinates, seven ratios, complete seven-by-seven covariance; no inherited metadata
joint.failure: None as a whole; no partial joint snapshots
